name: @unifiedai/sdk
description: Official SDK for Unifiedai marketplace apps.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run logos && bun run build:browser && bun run build:node && bun run build:logos-entry && bun run build:testing && bun run build:app && bun run build:app-testkit && bun run build:dev-host-api && bun run build:embed && bun run build:host-api && bun run build:vite && bun run build:types && bun run build:fixup-dts && bun run build:verify
scripts.build:browser: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --minify --sourcemap --entry-naming index.browser.js
scripts.build:node: bun build ./src/node/index.ts --outdir dist/node --target node --format esm --sourcemap --external @napi-rs/keyring --entry-naming index.js
scripts.build:logos-entry: bun build ./src/logos/index.ts --outdir dist/logos --target browser --format esm --minify --sourcemap --entry-naming index.js
scripts.build:testing: bun build ./src/testing/index.ts --outdir dist/testing --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --entry-naming index.js
scripts.build:app: bun build ./src/app/index.ts --outdir dist/app --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --entry-naming index.js
scripts.build:app-testkit: bun build ./src/app/testkit.ts --outdir dist/app --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --entry-naming testkit.js
scripts.build:dev-host-api: bun build ./src/app/dev-host-api.ts --outdir dist/app --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --entry-naming dev-host-api.js
scripts.build:embed: bun build ./src/app/embed.ts --outdir dist/app --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --entry-naming embed.js
scripts.build:host-api: bun build ./src/host-api/index.ts --outdir dist/host-api --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --entry-naming index.js && cp src/host-api/ambient.d.ts dist/host-api/ambient.d.ts
scripts.build:vite: bun build ./src/vite/index.ts --outdir dist/vite --target node --format esm --sourcemap --external vite --entry-naming index.js
scripts.test: bun run logos && bun test tests/core tests/node tests/bundle
